input.title: [SAMPLE] Opinion: the next decade of work will look different
input.body:
SAMPLE ARTICLE for the "Try a weak input" demo. It is deliberately vague, so the agents should not be able to publish anything from it.

Many people feel that the next decade of work will look very different from the last one. Change is in the air, and some observers think new tools could matter a great deal.

Nobody knows exactly how things will play out. Some leaders are excited, others are cautious, and most are waiting to see what happens next.

The author believes it is a good time to stay curious, keep learning, and pay attention to the conversation. Time will tell which ideas last.
